mapper.select: SELECT YMDHMS AS ymdhms, MAX_INBPS AS maxInVal, MAX_OUTBPS AS maxOutVal FROM ( SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(ETC , '|', 1) AS MNG_NO, SUBSTRING_INDEX(ETC , '|', -1) AS IF_IDX FROM CM_DASH_GRP WHERE DASH_KEY = #{dashKey} ) G, CM_IF_PERF_2 I WHERE G.MNG_NO = I.MNG_NO AND G.IF_IDX = I.IF_IDX AND YYYYMMDD BETWEEN #{date1} AND #{date2} AND YMDHMS BETWEEN CONCAT(#{date1},#{time1},'00') AND CONCAT(#{date2},#{time2},'59')

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(C1.USER_DEV_NAME,''), C1.DEV_NAME) AS DEV_NAME, IFNULL(NULLIF(C2.IF_NAME,''), C2.IF_DESCR) AS IF_NAME, IFNULL(CIPL.INBPS_RATE, '0') AS INBPS_RATE, IFNULL(CIPL.OUTBPS_RATE, '0') AS OUTBPS_RATE, (CIPL.INBPS_RATE + CIPL.OUTBPS_RATE)/2 AS BPS_RATE FROM CM_DEV10 C1 INNER JOIN CM_DEV20 C2 ON C1.MNG_NO = C2.MNG_NO INNER JOIN CM_IF_PERF_LAST CIPL ON CIPL.IF_IDX = C2.IF_IDX AND C2.MNG_NO = CIPL.MNG_NO WHERE C1.DEV_KIND1 = 'DEV' AND CIPL.LAST_UPD >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) ORDER BY (CIPL.INBPS_RATE + CIPL.OUTBPS_RATE) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT D.MNG_NO, G.GRP_NAME, IFNULL(NULLIF(D.USER_DEV_NAME,''), D.DEV_NAME) AS DEV_NAME, D.DEV_KIND1, D.DEV_IP, IFNULL(P.TEMP_VAL,0) AS CUR_VAL FROM NT_CFG_GROUP G, CM_DEV10 D, CM_DEV_PERF_LAST P WHERE G.GRP_NO = D.GRP_NO AND D.MNG_NO = P.MNG_NO AND D.DEV_KIND1 = 'DEV' AND G.GRP_NO IN ORDER BY CUR_VAL DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT A.* FROM( SELECT D.MNG_NO, G.GRP_NAME, IFNULL(NULLIF(D.USER_DEV_NAME,''), D.DEV_NAME) AS DEV_NAME, D.DEV_KIND1, D.DEV_IP, P.MEM_VAL AS CUR_VAL FROM NT_CFG_GROUP G, CM_DEV10 D, CM_DEV_PERF_LAST P WHERE G.GRP_NO = D.GRP_NO AND D.MNG_NO = P.MNG_NO AND D.DEV_KIND1 = 'DEV' AND G.GRP_NO IN )A ORDER BY CUR_VAL DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT D.MNG_NO, G.GRP_NAME, IFNULL(NULLIF(D.USER_DEV_NAME,''), D.DEV_NAME) AS DEV_NAME, D.DEV_KIND1, D.DEV_IP, P.CPU_VAL AS CUR_VAL FROM NT_CFG_GROUP G, CM_DEV10 D, CM_DEV_PERF_LAST P WHERE G.GRP_NO = D.GRP_NO AND D.MNG_NO = P.MNG_NO AND D.DEV_KIND1 = 'DEV' AND G.GRP_NO IN ORDER BY CUR_VAL DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT IFNULL( NULLIF(A.USER_DEV_NAME, ''), A.DEV_NAME ) AS DEV_NAME, IFNULL( NULLIF(B.USER_IF_NAME, ''), B.IF_NAME ) AS IF_NAME, C.AVG_INBPS, C.AVG_OUTBPS FROM CM_DEV10 A, CM_DEV20 B, CM_IF_PERF_LAST C, NT_CFG_GROUP G WHERE A.MNG_NO = B.MNG_NO AND B.IF_IDX = C.IF_IDX AND B.MNG_NO = C.MNG_NO AND A.GRP_NO = G.GRP_NO AND G.GRP_NO IN ORDER BY AVG_INBPS DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY B.RESP_VAL DESC) AS RN, IFNULL( NULLIF(A.USER_DEV_NAME, ''), A.DEV_NAME ) AS DEV_NAME, B.RESP_VAL FROM CM_DEV10 A, CM_DEV_PERF_LAST B, NT_CFG_GROUP G WHERE A.MNG_NO = B.MNG_NO AND A.GRP_NO = G.GRP_NO AND G.GRP_NO IN ORDER BY RN ASC LIMIT 5;
